posts.text:
We look forward to an Attorney General who restores law and order and holds rich and powerful predators accountable. 

The American people deserve results. No more two-tiered justice system.

RELEASE THE EPSTEIN FILES.

Video

MACE WIN: We've secured $944.8 MILLION in NDAA authorizations for Lowcountry military installations since coming to Congress.

The Lowcountry is a leader when it comes to national defense and is home to one of the largest military populations in the country. 

South Carolina STRONG.

We’re praying for our servicemembers overseas right now and for the aircrew whose plane was shot down in Iran today. 

It is far past time we bring our troops home.
The top prosecutor MUST hold predators accountable. The American people deserve answers.

Thanking God and U.S. forces for the rescue of one of our servicemembers after their aircraft was shot down over Iran today.

We are praying for a full recovery and for the safe return of the still-missing pilot.

Our military is the strongest and best in the world. God bless our brave troops and the United States of America.

MACE WIN: We supported $30,000 in funding for Dorchester Paws

Every animal walking through a shelter door is counting on someone to care. Not every shelter can keep up. Dorchester Paws does. Their team stands up for, protects, and cares for the voiceless every single day.

As the number of animals in shelters rises, so does the need for staff. This grant helped Dorchester Paws attain proper staffing to provide every animal coming through their doors with the care it deserves.

South Carolina ST
Attorney General or not, our subpoena still stands. We still have questions we want answered.

If the reports that Lee Zeldin will be replacing Pam Bondi as Attorney General are true - I welcome it.

Bondi handled the Epstein Files in a terrible manner and made this situation far worse than it had to be for President Trump.

I look forward to a new Attorney General committed to getting justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.

BREAKING: Attorney General Pam Bondi FIRED.

Bondi handled the Epstein Files in a terrible manner and seriously undermined President Trump.

She has stonewalled every effort to hold the guilty accountable. The American people deserve an Attorney General who is transparent and delivers real accountability.

We look forward to a new Attorney General who is committed to getting justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.

Pam Bondi will soon leave her job as the Attorney General.

My subpoena still stands. When the Oversight Committee moved to subpoena Bondi, I did it by name, not by or not as the sitting Attorney General of the U.S.

RELEASE THE EPSTEIN FILES.

We met with leaders from the Aircraft Carrier Industrial Base Coalition to discuss keeping America’s Navy the strongest in the world.

Aircraft carriers are the backbone of our strength at sea, and companies like these show us how to build them smarter, with more predictability, lower costs, and a workforce we never leave behind.

Let’s build smarter and stay ready.

Today we remember the crucifixion of our Savior, Jesus Christ. He carried our sins so we wouldn’t have to walk alone. 

Wishing the Lowcountry and all of South Carolina a blessed Good Friday. 🙏

We see crimes being committed. We see people defrauding the government. And too often, it seems like no one is held accountable.

As a Member of Congress, we get a front-row seat to all of it. When we tried to subpoena Ilhan Omar and her brother/husband's immigration records, it was Republicans who blocked it. Both parties always protect each other.

Video

INTRODUCING: The FETCH Act to expand and reinforce how law enforcement agencies can use existing federal grant funding to support K-9 units.

Police K-9 units are one of the most effective tools in law enforcement and keeping our communities safe. 

These dogs save lives, stop crime, and protect the men and women in uniform who put themselves in harm’s way every day. Our bill ensures law enforcement can fully leverage existing resources to train, equip, and care for these K-9 partners from their

MACE WIN: Over the past five years, we’ve helped thousands of constituents, closing 13,253 cases and counting.

Whether it’s VA issues, passports, or tax returns, our office is here to help with any federal agency.

South Carolina STRONG.

I want an Attorney General who will make arrests, who will prosecute, and who will put criminals in jail.

And I want ALL the Epstein files released. 

No more two-tier system of justice.
